## Equipment Inventory & Pricing
- **DJI Mini 4 Pro Fly More Combo:** 4K/60fps HDR Drone (<249g), 3 batteries (100+ mins flight), DJI RC screen controller, 128GB MicroSD. Rate: Rs. 10,000 / day | Rs. 18,000 / 2 days | Rs. 55,000 / 7 days.
- **DJI Osmo Mobile SE:** 3-Axis Foldable Smartphone Stabilizer with ActiveTrack. Rate: Rs. 1,200 / day | Rs. 2,200 / 2 days | Rs. 6,000 / 7 days.
- **DJI Osmo Mobile 7P:** ActiveTrack 7.0 Flagship Gimbal with extension rod & magnetic fill-light module. Rate: Rs. 1,800 / day | Rs. 3,200 / 2 days | Rs. 9,000 / 7 days.
- **JBL PartyBox Stage 320:** 240W Party Speaker with dynamic lightshow & swappable battery. Rate: Rs. 4,000 / day (Speaker Only) | Rs. 5,000 / day (With Dual Mics).
- **JBL Wireless Dual Microphones:** UHF dual wireless vocal microphones with rechargeable receiver. Rate: Rs. 2,000 / day.

## Key Policies
- **Payment:** Zero upfront card charges. Reserve online, inspect gear physically, and settle payment at store pickup.
- **Handover Requirements:** Valid National Identity Card (NIC), Sri Lankan Driving License, or Passport presented in-store.
- **Aviation Compliance:** Drone operations briefed in-store under Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka (CAASL) rules.
